command.name: Whirlwind
verbatim: Rounds 2, 4, 6, 8: 20% chance to grant 2 other Allies in any lane Advantage (+15%) for 2 round(s).
Rounds 3, 5, 7, 9: Deal Tactical Damage to 3 Enemies in any lane (Damage Rate: +45%).

At 10 Stars: Each Round: 12% chance to Cleanse 1 instance of Bleed, Panic, or Burn from each Ally. Rounds 2, 4, 6, 8: Apply Recovery to 3 Allies in any lane (Recovery Rate: +18%, enhanced by Initiative).

vanguard.name: Sentinel's Wit
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase your Tactical Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Strategic Leader
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Tactical Damage Dealt by +17% of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Vanguard) until the end of combat.

habits.name: Quick Reflexes
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Instinct and Initiative by +22.4% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Gales of Power
habits.verbatim: Rounds 2, 4, 6, 8: 14% chance to grant First-Strike to 3 Allies in any lane and afflict Slow on 3 Enemies in any lane. Each effect is checked separately per target and lasts for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Fierce Unity
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Strength and Instinct by +5% (enhanced by Initiative) of 3 Allies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Breath of Renewal
verbatim: Whirlwind gains: Each Round: 12% chance to Cleanse 1 instance of Bleed, Panic, or Burn from each Ally. This chance is checked separately per target.
Rounds 2, 4, 6, 8: Apply Recovery to 3 Allies in any lane (Recovery Rate: +18%, enhanced by Initiative).
